description: This file defines the code-behind class for an ASP.NET Web Forms page called TheorySet. It manages UI interactions related to course selection, question addition, and exam setup within an online examination system. The code handles events such as page load, button clicks, dropdown selection changes, and interacts with a SQL database to store and retrieve examination data.

classes.name: TheorySet
classes.description: Partial class for the ASP.NET page 'TheorySet', derived from System.Web.UI.Page, handling user interactions and database logic for managing theory questions and course details in the online exam system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event. Currently, it contains commented-out code that might initialize session variables or UI elements.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminPanel.aspx page when the 'home' button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers to AdminQueue.aspx when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers to AdminLeaderboard.aspx when the leaderboard button is clicked.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on the selected semester from the dropdown list, dynamically adding course options.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Inserts a new theory question into the 'theoryQS' table, updates question number, and provides user feedback.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Adds exam detail into 'theoryCourseDetail' table and navigates to AdminPanel.aspx with an alert.

methods.name: clearB_Click
methods.description: Clears the text fields related to question input.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by transferring to LoginPage.aspx.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the course dropdown options based on the semester selected.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Calculates and sets the question number based on the selected course.
